description: This file contains configuration data and functions for setting up PLL (Phase-Locked Loop) parameters on an ARM1136 architecture, including PLL configuration structures, constants, and functions to configure and set PLL frequencies.

methods.name: plla_configure
methods.description: Configures PLLA with specified parameters and waits for lock.

methods.name: plla_set_config
methods.description: Sets PLLA to a specified MHz frequency by selecting the appropriate configuration.
